Arthritic Conditions
Deﬁ nition and Epidemiology
Arthritic conditions encompass more than 100 diﬀ erent dis-
eases and conditions aﬀ ecting the joints, the tissues surround-
ing the joints, and the connective tissues. Often referred to as 
“arthritis,” arthritic conditions are among the most common
diseases in the world and include osteoarthritis, rheumatoid
arthritis, and gout, which are addressed in this section.47 Ar-
thritic conditions aﬀ ect nearly one in six North Americans and 
are the leading cause of disability among Americans 18 years 
of age and older.48 Among Americans 65 years of age and older, 
arthritic symptoms are second only to hypertension as the most 
commonly reported chronic condition. It is estimated that by 
the year 2020, approximately 60 million Americans will be af-
fected by arthritic conditions.
